review:
This is a very short, but really interesting and fun to play demo for VR.

It's also the first demo to make my 1060 struggle, which was quite surprising, considering I didn't expect much. But the graphics are beautiful, and the setting quite captivating.

I'd definitely like to see this fleshed out, perhaps as a VR short story.
A great example of something which isnt a terribly new idea but a brand new way of presenting it, and for free! Nothing to lose

Love the the gameplay and concept behind this game. I played it multiple times because you have to in order to find all of the plots. However, I enjoyed doing the different scenarios and it makes sense to look at each one. This was overall a very good demo for people who like to play a detective role or just like to solve problems. I highly recommend it to anybody who likes to solve problems.
Fun experiance but it sadly is too short. Great example of what could come in the future though.

Amazing idea and creativity.  I hope we'll be experiencing other outstanding creations from you... once you all graduate :)

Great concept, and expansion beyond a demo/tech demo would be really cool.  I like the idea of having to play time forward and backward to figure out what happened.  It's interesting to see what you think is the root cause, and then see the real thing.

I didn't see the branching storyline points though.  Perhaps I need to explore more.

Un piccolo Life is Strange in VR.

Non è propriamente un gioco, quanto un'esperienza di 5-10 minuti: il tutto accade in un bar, ci sono una decina di personaggi, e il vostro compito è solo quello di assistere a ciò che accade (è necessario conoscere un po' di inglese, perché non ci sono sottotitoli). Non c'è interazione con la scena, tutto ciò che potete fare è mandare avanti o indietro il tempo, per capire cosa ha causato cosa. La grafica è molto gradevole ed è tutto molto immersivo. Lo consiglio come esperienza VR, non come gioco, poiché è sprovvisto di un gameplay vero e proprio.

Eine kurze Szene in einer Bar, die man als aus beliebigen Blickwinkeln betrachten und vor- oder zurückspulen kann. Ein interessanter Ansatz für ein Spiel, in dem man Handlungen beeinflussen und den Lauf der Dinge verändern könnte. In dieser Gratis-Demo darf man aber leider nur zuschauen.

Für ein Spiel ist das zu wenig. Da Quanero VR nichts kostet, solltet ihr aber unbedingt (etwa eine halbe Stunde lang) reinschauen!
